name: North Dakota

response.rule_text: Public entity must respond within a reasonable time; AG opinion 98-O-22 says usually hours or a few days. No fixed deadline.

fees.labor_rule: Up to $25/hour per request for locating records and for redaction, excluding the first hour; advance payment may be required.
fees.copy_rule: Up to $0.25 per impression for paper; non-paper copies at reasonable fee (actual cost incl. labor, materials, equipment); postage at actual cost.

residency.rule_text: Any member of the public may request; no reason or identity required (§ 44-04-18).

appeal.body: Attorney General opinion, then district court civil action
appeal.rule_text: Request AG opinion within 30 days of alleged violation (§ 44-04-21.1); entity then has 7 days to disclose if violation found. Civil action within 60 days of when requester knew of violation or 30 days after AG opinion, whichever later (§ 44-04-21.2).

format_rule: Electronic records in print or another available medium; no duty to create records or provide different structure (§ 44-04-18).
notes: Read chars 0-100k and 150-250k. Delay as denial: statute silent. Executive branch covered (§ 44-04-17.1(13)(i)), governor's office not separately named. Legislature covered with exemptions (§ 44-04-18.6). School districts: N.D.C.C. § 15.1-07-25.  AG-request deadline null: the 30-day unit is not labeled by RCFP.
